We know Blackpink members: Jisoo (Kim Ji-soo) born 1995, Jennie (Kim Jennie) born 1996, Rosé (Park Chae-young) born 1997, Lisa (Lalisa Manoban) born 1997 (or 1997? Actually Lisa born March 27, 1997). Wait, Jisoo born Jan 3, 1995; Jennie born Jan 16, 1996; Rosé born Feb 11, 1997; Lisa born March 27, 1997. Provide answer. Should verify maybe. Could also include full birth dates but the user only asked year. Provide concise answer.
